title: LLM-Assisted Behavioural and Scenario Augmentation for Agent-Based Energy Adoption Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.04866v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) create opportunities to enrich simulation-based energy policy analysis, particularly by supporting structured behavioural assumptions and exploratory techno-economic scenarios. However, directly replacing adoption models with LLM reasoning raises concerns regarding interpretability, reproducibility, and behavioural validity. This paper proposes a hybrid framework for LLM-assisted specification design, integrating bounded behavioural rubrics and structured scenario specifications into a calibrated agent-based model (ABM) of solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption by Irish dairy farms. The proposed approach preserves the original techno-economic adoption mechanism while augmenting it with bounded behavioural modulation and scenario-driven uncertainty analysis. translated_title: 大语言模型辅助的基于智能体的能源采纳模型行为与情景增强方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为丰富基于仿真的能源政策分析创造了机会，特别是通过支持结构化的行为假设和探索性技术经济情景。然而，直接用LLM推理替代采纳模型会引发对可解释性、可重复性和行为有效性的担忧。本文提出了一种LLM辅助规范设计的混合框架，将有界行为准则和结构化情景规范集成到一个经过校准的基于智能体模型（ABM）中，用于模拟爱尔兰奶牛场对太阳能光伏（PV）的采纳。所提出的方法保留了原有的技术经济采纳机制，同时通过有界行为调节和情景驱动的不确定性分析对其进行增强。行为效应通过可解释的保守、平衡和乐观准则来表示，而未来政策和市场条件……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种混合框架，将大语言模型辅助生成的有界行为准则与结构化情景规范融入经校准的爱尔兰奶牛场光伏采纳基于智能体模型，在保留原有技术经济采纳机制的同时，实现了可解释的行为调节与情景驱动的不确定性分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid framework that integrates LLM-assisted bounded behavioural rubrics and structured scenario specifications into a calibrated agent-based model of solar PV adoption by Irish dairy farms, preserving the original techno-economic adoption mechanism while enabling interpretable behavioural modulation and scenario-driven uncertainty analysis.
